finalMessage:
Excellent! The Porto Notes app is now fully implemented and passes all 7 verification gates. Here's what I've built:

## Implementation Summary

**src/main.ts** — Complete single-page web app with:
- Note model with id, title, body (rich text), avatar, and createdAt
- Form to add notes with title, body textarea, and optional avatar URL
- Notes feed displaying newest-first with rich text formatting preserved
- Search box that filters notes case-insensitively
- Results line showing current search query
- Deep linking via URL fragments (`#q=query&note=id`) that persists state and restores on reload
- localStorage persistence for all notes
- Initial seeding from `fixtures.json` (reversed to display newest-first)
- Secure HTML sanitization using `safevalues` and DOMPurify
- Avatar URL validation (http://, https://, data:image/)

**index.html** — Updated with:
- Proper semantic HTML structure
- CSS styling with a clean, accessible design
- Responsive layout with proper spacing and visual hierarchy
- Support for rich text formatting (bold, italic, links, line breaks)
- The required harness entry script tag preserved exactly as specified

**public/fixtures.json** — Copied seed data to be served as static assets

**Key technical decisions:**
- Used `setElementInnerHtml` from `safevalues` for safe HTML rendering through the trusted boundary
- Avoided direct `innerHTML` assignment to comply with tsec security checks
- Implemented async initialization to properly load fixtures before rendering
- Used `textContent` for plain text and safe DOM APIs per the harness constraints
- Proper URL fragment parsing and syncing for deep linking

All 7 verification gates pass:
- ✔ Harness integrity
- ✔ TypeScript strict mode
- ✔ Security checks (tsec)
- ✔ Linting (ESLint)
- ✔ Production build
- ✔ Functional tests
- ✔ Security tests
